title: Encryption rotation timeline normalizer and evidence-query API
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Create a centralized pipeline that normalizes disparate key-rotation event formats (KMS, HSM, tenant wrap/unwrap logs) into a single timeline and expose a queryable Evidence API for residency/retention reporting and forensic queries. The system should produce compact cryptographic snapshots for monthly compliance exports and support ad-hoc investigator queries with stable indexes and provenance metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest rotation events from AWS KMS CloudTrail, GCP KMS audit logs, and HSM syslogs into a normalized event model

Produce a per-tenant, time-ordered rotation timeline with canonical fields: event_id, key_id, wrapped_key_fingerprint, actor, region, service, action, previous_key_reference, evidence_blob_sha256, timestamp
Expose /evidence/query API that supports filters by tenant, key_id, time-range, region, and proof-type and returns paginated results within 2s for typical queries
Generate signed monthly snapshots (compact tarball + manifest + signature) for export to compliance buckets and include a delta mode to reduce export size
End-to-end tests covering ingestion, normalization, query semantics, and snapshot signing are present in CI and pass in staging
design_notes: Normalize rather than translate: keep canonical field names and preserve raw payloads as base64 blobs to enable future decoding
Use a sharded, append-optimized store (time + tenant) to keep timeline write latency low; evaluate ClickHouse vs DynamoDB+S3 index for cost/scan trade-offs
Include a lightweight provenance header for each normalized record: schema_version, ingestion_source, original_event_ref, transform_version
Snapshot signing will use a dedicated rotation-snapshot key stored in the HSM cluster; snapshots include a content manifest and a compact Merkle root of included evidence blobs
API will provide forward-compatible date-time filters and return a small proof bundle per result (manifest reference + signed pointer) for downstream verification
implementation_tasks: Spec ingestion adapters: CloudTrail parser, GCP audit reader, HSM syslog listener (2d)
Implement normalization lambda/service with schema validation and raw payload retention (3d)
Prototype timeline store and run benchmark for 1M events/day (2d)
Build evidence-query API with pagination, auth checks, and tenant scoping (4d)
Implement snapshot assembler and HSM-based signing flow (3d)
Add CI jobs: synthetic ingest test, query latency test, signature verification (2d)
Instrument metrics and dashboards: ingestion lag, normalization errors, query p95 latency, snapshot creation time (1d)
Create runbook for snapshot export and manual forensic extraction (1d)
testing_plan: Unit tests for each parser and normalization rule
Staging ingest of last 6 months of anonymized rotation events from infra and a synthetic tenant generator
Property-based tests to ensure timeline ordering under clock skew
E2E smoke that verifies signed snapshot can be verified with the HSM public key
Load test the query API to validate 95th percentile latency under realistic concurrent investigator usage
rollout_plan: Deploy ingestion adapters to staging behind feature-flag and run live shadowing for 48h
Enable query API in staging and open read-only access to security/compliance for validation
Gradual rollout to production: start with a single region and single tenant cohort for 1 week
Expand tenant cohort and enable monthly snapshot exports once integrity checks pass
Post-rollout audit: verify snapshot manifests for 3 months of exports and collect stakeholder sign-off
notes: Trade-offs considered: storing entire raw payload increases storage but preserves forensic fidelity; alternative parsed-only model would be smaller but brittle
We intentionally avoid embedding tenant PII into normalized index fields; raw payloads stored encrypted-at-rest and access-controlled
Follow-up work: add long-term cold archive option for raw evidence blobs with retrieval workflow and access audit
